title: Reading, Writing, and Rounding Whole Numbers
instructions: Answer all questions. For short-answer and fill-in-the-blank, use only one word, number, or letter.

hints: 4 is less than 5, so do not round up.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The tens digit is 4, so 6,749 rounds down to 6,700.

questions.prompt: How many zeros are in 1 million?

hints: The hundred thousands place is the second digit from the left.
questions.prompt: Which digit is in the hundred thousands place in 4,325,678?
The group name for 1,000,000,000 is one ___.
How is 3.7 million written as a whole number?
hints: Drop the decimal point (37) and add zeros until the first digit is in the millions place.

questions.feedbackIfWrong: Do not say 'and' – 804 is 'eight hundred four'.
questions.prompt: What word should not be used when reading the whole number 804?

hints: The 2 is in the thousands place.

hints: No mention of hundreds or tens.
